stem.text: The diagram was drawn from an electron micrograph of an animal cell.

stem.alt: Outline drawing of an animal cell showing internal organelles.

stem.text: Which diagram would represent the same cell viewed with a simple light microscope, using daylight as the only light source?

A.alt: Outline drawing of a cell with a nucleus and fewer internal structures.

B.alt: Outline drawing of a cell with a nucleus and several internal structures.

C.alt: Outline drawing of a cell with a nucleus and several internal structures.

D.alt: Outline drawing of a cell with a nucleus and several internal structures.
